name: Call Me Cera
source:
Ever just wanna run away to a cottage in the woods. . .
Surrounded by a loving group of kind, interesting friends. . .
And feel. . . happy?

Same. So what do we do?
Impulsively move to a picturesque town and start over!
And somehow make friends.

Hi, I'm Cera. Wanna be friends?

A wholesome game about making friends as an adult. 

[From [URL=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1523870/]Steam[/URL]]
translation:
曾经只想逃到树林里的小屋里。。。
周围有一群充满爱心、友善、有趣的朋友。。。
并感觉。。。快乐的？

相同的。那么我们该怎么办呢？
冲动地搬到风景如画的小镇，重新开始！
并以某种方式交朋友。

嗨，我是塞拉。想成为朋友吗？

一款关于成年人交朋友的有益健康的游戏。

[来自 [URL=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1523870/]Steam[/URL]]
